stage1.impression: A dark timber-boarded alcove with a smoked slab basin, but the basin reads as a blown white oval cut into a flat dark box: the 'glow through the thickness' is not there, the slab's faces are featureless, and the board grain is smooth and CG-like. It reads as a showroom render detail, not a photograph of a specific bar's washroom; a magazine would not run it as a picture of a specific place.

blocking_9: Basin glow under clipping and warm: region [245,262,525,358] clip_pct < 2 and r_median-b_median >= 60 (now clip 34.6 %, RGB 245/227/216, delta-E 25.7 vs #E0A060)
Slab front and side faces show the light passing through 120 mm of smoked acrylic: a visible gradient on [90,360,640,470] (lum_range >= 40, now 12.4) and a glowing polished top arris
Left edge not a black void: [0,0,90,480] crush_pct < 50 (now 86.9 % on 12.5 % of the frame)
Brief's props in frame: linen towel on a brass rod, plus one sign of use (a drop of water, a soap, a folded hand towel)
Timber boards with real fir/oak character at 1:1 (checks, varied grain, slight board-to-board tone variation) rather than smooth repeated texture
Unexplained white/cream panel with a copper pip at upper left [200,70,290,215] resolved or dressed

defects.what: Basin interior clipped (34.6 % of pixels at 255) and near white, not the warm amber the brief asks for; reads as a light box, not a lit acrylic bowl
Slab front face flat dark brown (lum_median 21.5, range 12.4); no sign of 120 mm acrylic, no edge glow, no internal light; reads as a painted MDF box
Top of slab: ghostly doubled reflections of the wall boards and tap, slightly wobbly; top arris has no highlight, so the thickness doesn't read
Small bright blob below the basin (drain or tap reflection) floating mid-face, reads as an artefact
Left band crushed to black (crush_pct 86.9 %), larger than a tenth of the frame
Blank cream rectangle with a copper pip on the wall: unidentified object, reads as placeholder geometry
Timber boards smooth and evenly grained, look like a tiled wood texture; no checks, no board-to-board variation
Spout reads as polished chrome rather than brushed steel; geometry soft and slightly rubbery at the bend
No towel, brass rod or sign of life; frame is empty and showroom-like

changes.problem: The basin is a clipped white oval rather than a warm glow.

change.setting: the sink's under-glow (emission strength) and the sink spot
change.to: under-glow 0.6 with emission colour #FFB070 (about 2200 K); sink spot 1.5 W 2400 K

changes.expected: Basin reads as a warm amber bowl with a gradient from rim to centre, no clipped area beyond a small specular.

changes.problem: The slab's faces are flat dark and show no light passing through the acrylic thickness.

change.setting: smoked acrylic finish (absorption/volume density of the sink slab) and the under-glow's placement
change.from: smoke dense enough to read opaque
change.to: lower volume absorption so the under-glow scatters through ~120 mm and the polished arrises catch it; keep the tint Smoke

changes.expected: Front face darkens from a warm glow near the basin/top edge to deep smoke at the bottom; top arris shows a thin bright line.

changes.problem: The brief's towel on a brass rod and any sign of use are missing, so the frame reads as a showroom.

evidence.measured: seen: no towel, rod, soap or water anywhere in frame

change.to: linen towel (oatmeal, slightly creased) on the brass rod at the slab's right end, in frame; a small amber glass soap bottle on the slab's back corner; a few water droplets in the bowl

changes.expected: A second warm material and a sign of life; the brass catches a highlight from the basin.

changes.problem: The left 90 px are a black void and the framing gives the slab no edge to show its thickness.

change.to: move about 0.25 m along +x and lower to 1.15 m so the slab's left end sits inside the frame with its polished end face showing, and the alcove's dark side wall is cropped out

changes.expected: The slab's end grain-less polished face shows its 120 mm thickness; no large crushed band.

changes.problem: Timber boards read as a smooth tiled texture, not real boards.

evidence.measured: lum_range 34.5, even grain repeating board to board; seen at 1:1

change.to: per-board random tone offset (+/-10 %), a bump map with fine checks and open grain, slight sheen variation (roughness 0.45-0.65)

changes.expected: Board-to-board variation and grain relief catch the low raking light from the basin.

changes.problem: The wall above the slab is lit evenly with no pool from the basin, flattening the alcove.

evidence.measured: lum_median 42.4, nearly the same as wall at [200,70,285,215] 36.4

change.setting: the sink spot cone and the exposure
change.to: cone 18 deg aimed into the bowl; exposure 0.6, so the wall is lit mainly by the bowl's bounce and falls off upward

changes.expected: Light falls off upward from the slab: lower wall brighter than upper.

changes.problem: A blank cream panel with a copper pip on the upper-left wall reads as placeholder geometry.

change.to: crop it out with c4, or replace it with a small smoked-glass mirror or framed print in a blackened-steel frame

changes.problem: The spout reads as polished chrome, not brushed steel.

evidence.measured: lum_p95 82 against median 40: sharp specular streaks

change.to: roughness 0.35 with anisotropy 0.6 along the spout's axis

changes.expected: Soft, elongated highlights along the spout instead of mirror streaks.

out_of_scope.request: A rounder, deeper basin profile with a softened rim so the glow grades over a curved surface
out_of_scope.why: The sink's shape is fixed by the card; only its glow and finish may change

out_of_scope.request: An EARF product in frame for the frame's single saturated colour
out_of_scope.why: The card defines this as a sink detail; adding a speaker would change the composition the room's design fixes
